chunks: Al-Kafi: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hajjal, from Abi Ishaq Tha'laba, from Zurara ibn A'yan, from One of the two (Imams), peace be upon them, who said:
Allah has not been worshipped by something like Bada'.

key_terms.الْبَدَاءِ: Bada' (Divine manifestation or change of decree)

ai.seo_question: What is the highest form of worship according to the concept of Bada' in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir or Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon them) identifies 'Bada'' as the pinnacle of worship, elevating it beyond mere ritual acts. This reflects the Shia theological view that recognizing Allah's ability to alter decrees according to His wisdom is a profound intellectual and spiritual acknowledgment of His absolute power. Such understanding fosters hope and resilience, as believers realize that supplication and good deeds can change their fate.

en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/359] al-Kafi: Muhammad b. Yahya from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from al-Hajjal from Abi Ishaq Tha’laba from Zurara b. A’yan from One of the two عليهما السلام who said:
Allah has not been worshipped by something like Bada’
